termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern the relationship between Atlas Fold ("we", "us", "our") and the client ("you", "your") who purchases local SEO services from us. By signing up or making a payment, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

section1.title: 1. Service Description
section1.p1: Atlas Fold provides Google Business Profile (Google Maps) optimisation services with the goal of improving your local search ranking in Sofia, Bulgaria. The specific deliverables depend on the package you purchase:
items: <highlight>Full competitor analysis</highlight> - a review of the top-ranking competitors in your niche and locality.
<highlight>Google Business Profile optimisation</highlight> - categories, attributes, photos, business description, Q&A, and citation building.
<highlight>Bi-weekly updates</highlight> - ongoing optimisation activities carried out every two weeks throughout the engagement.
<highlight>Website optimisation</highlight> - included in the Standard and Quarterly packages; limited in the Minimum package.
<highlight>Authority signal building</highlight> - high-quality local citations and backlinks relevant to your business category.
section1.p2: We do not manage Google Ads, Meta Ads, or any paid advertising channels. Our services are exclusively organic local SEO.

section2.title: 2. Pricing & Payment Terms
items: Invoices are issued at the start of each billing period and are payable within 5 business days.
All prices are in euros (EUR) and exclude any applicable VAT.
Failure to pay within the agreed period may result in suspension of services.
Prices may be revised with 30 days' written notice for ongoing clients.

section3.title: 3. The 90-Day Top 3 Guarantee
section3.p1: The <highlight>Standard</highlight> and <highlight>Quarterly</highlight> packages include a guarantee: if your business does not reach the Top 3 on Google Maps for the agreed primary search term within 90 days of service commencement, you will not be charged for the work performed in that period (i.e., a full refund of amounts already paid is issued, or the outstanding balance is waived).
section3.p2: Guarantee conditions - the guarantee applies only when:
items: You have granted us the necessary access to your Google Business Profile and website within 5 business days of onboarding.
You have not made material changes to your Google Business Profile, website, or business name without our knowledge during the 90-day period.
Your Google Business Profile was not suspended during the engagement for any reason attributable to you.
Payment has been made on time for all billing periods.
The agreed primary search term was not changed after the start of the engagement.
section3.p3: The <highlight>Minimum</highlight> package does not include a money-back guarantee. It targets first-page visibility, not a guaranteed Top 3 placement.

section4.title: 4. Cancellation & Contract Term
items: <highlight>Minimum & Standard packages</highlight>: require a minimum 3-month commitment. After this initial period, you may cancel at any time by providing written notice (email) at least 14 days before the next billing date.
<highlight>Quarterly package</highlight>: renews automatically every 3 months. You may cancel by providing written notice at least 14 days before the renewal date.
Cancellation during the minimum commitment period does not entitle you to a refund of amounts already paid.
Upon termination, we will remove our access credentials from your Google Business Profile and website within 5 business days.

section5.title: 5. Client Obligations
items: You agree to provide timely access and accurate information required for onboarding.
You confirm that you are the legitimate owner or authorised manager of the Google Business Profile in question.
You agree not to take actions that may interfere with our optimisation work (e.g., removing edits, adding conflicting categories, spamming reviews).

section6.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
section6.p1: Local search rankings are determined by Google's algorithms, which are outside our control. While we apply industry best practices, we cannot guarantee specific ranking positions beyond the Top 3 guarantee outlined in Section 3. In no event shall Atlas Fold be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services, including but not limited to loss of revenue or business opportunities. Our total liability is limited to the amounts paid by you in the most recent billing period.

section7.title: 7. Governing Law
section7.p1: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Bulgaria. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Sofia.

section8.title: 8. Contact
section8.p1: For any questions regarding these Terms, please contact us at <emailLink>antoan@atlasfold.com</emailLink> or by phone at <phoneLink>0 877 268 727</phoneLink>.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: Atlas Fold ("we", "us", "our") is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, where it is stored, and what rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable Bulgarian law.

section2.title: 2. What Data We Collect
section2.p1: We collect personal data that you voluntarily provide when you fill out the lead capture form on our website. Specifically, we collect:
items: <highlight>Full name</highlight> - so we know who we are contacting.
<highlight>Phone number</highlight> - to call you within 24 hours as stated on the form.
<highlight>City</highlight> - to understand your service area and tailor our analysis.
<highlight>Industry</highlight> - to assess your niche competition before we call.
<highlight>Selected package</highlight> - the pricing tier you indicated interest in.
section2.p2: We do not collect sensitive personal data (e.g., health, financial account details, national ID numbers).

section3.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
section3.p1: Your data is used solely for the purpose of:
items: Contacting you to discuss your free Google Maps analysis
Qualifying you as a potential client and preparing a tailored proposal
Maintaining a record of our communication for follow-up purposes
section3.p2: We do not use your data for automated decision-making or profiling.

section4.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
section4.p1: We process your data on the basis of <highlight>legitimate interest</highlight> (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) - specifically, our legitimate interest in following up on your explicit request for a free analysis. By submitting the form, you are initiating contact with us and expecting a response.

section5.title: 5. Where Your Data Is Stored
section5.p1: Submitted form data is stored in a private <highlight>Notion</highlight> workspace accessible only to Atlas Fold. Notion is a cloud-based tool operated by Notion Labs, Inc. (USA), which provides adequate data protection through its GDPR compliance measures. No other third parties have access to your data.
section5.p2: A notification email is also sent to an internal Atlas Fold email address via <highlight>Resend</highlight> (a transactional email service) at the moment of form submission. Resend does not store the content of the email beyond transient delivery logging.

section6.title: 6. Data Sharing & Third Parties
section6.p1: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with any third parties for marketing or commercial purposes. Your data is never used for advertising targeting or sold to data brokers.

section7.title: 7. Data Retention
section7.p1: We keep your data for as long as there is an active business relationship or a reasonable follow-up period (typically up to 12 months after your last contact with us). If you become a client, we retain relevant records for the duration of our engagement and up to 5 years thereafter, as required by Bulgarian accounting and commercial law.

section8.title: 8. Your Rights
section8.p1: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
items: <highlight>Right of access</highlight> - you can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
<highlight>Right to rectification</highlight> - you can ask us to correct inaccurate data.
<highlight>Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")</highlight> - you can request deletion of your personal data. We will action this within 30 days.
<highlight>Right to restriction</highlight> - you can ask us to stop processing your data in certain circumstances.
<highlight>Right to object</highlight> - you can object to processing based on legitimate interest.
section8.p2: To exercise any of these rights, please email us at <emailLink>antoan@atlasfold.com</emailLink> with the subject line <italic>"Data Request - [your name]"</italic>. We will respond within 30 days.
section8.p3: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the <highlight>Commission for Personal Data Protection</highlight> (CPDP) of Bulgaria at <cpdpLink>www.cpdp.bg</cpdpLink>.

section9.title: 9. Policy Updates
section9.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. We encourage you to review this page periodically.

faqPage.title: Everything you need to know about
faqPage.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about Google Maps optimisation, our service, and the guarantee.

q1.question: What is local SEO and how does it differ from regular SEO?
q1.answer: Local SEO is search engine optimisation specifically for location-based searches - like 'plumber in Sofia' or 'dentist near me'. Unlike traditional SEO that targets standard organic results, local SEO focuses on the 'map pack' - the three businesses displayed on Google Maps. These searches have the highest buyer intent of any search type.

q2.question: What is Google Business Profile and do I need one?
q2.answer: Google Business Profile (GBP) is the free business listing that controls how your company appears on Google Maps and Search. Without a verified and optimised GBP, it is virtually impossible to rank in the Top 3. It is the foundation of everything we do - without it, even the best optimisation cannot work.

q3.question: Do I need a website to rank on Google Maps?
q3.answer: Not strictly required, but strongly recommended. A website sends additional authority signals to Google. Our Standard and Quarterly packages include full website optimisation. If you don't have a website, we can still help - but results will be significantly stronger with one.

q1.question: What exactly does your service include?
q1.answer: Every package includes: full competitor analysis, Google Business Profile optimisation (categories, attributes, photos, description, Q&A), high-quality citation and authority signal building, and bi-weekly updates. The Standard and Quarterly packages also include full website optimisation.

q2.question: Can you help us get more Google reviews?
q2.answer: Yes. We provide proven strategies and templates for collecting reviews without violating Google's policies. Reviews are a key ranking signal - more quality reviews directly improve your position in the map pack and build trust with potential customers.

q3.question: Which industries do you work with?
q3.answer: We work with any local business that serves customers face-to-face: plumbers, dentists, lawyers, accountants, auto repair shops, restaurants, hotels, beauty salons, gyms, and many more. If your customers search for businesses like yours on Google - we can help.

q4.question: What happens after the initial 90-day period?
q4.answer: Once you have reached the Top 3, we work to maintain and strengthen your position. The competitive landscape shifts over time - regular maintenance ensures you stay ahead. You can continue month-to-month or switch to the quarterly plan with a built-in discount.

q1.question: How quickly will we see movement in rankings?
q1.answer: Most clients see initial movement within 4–6 weeks. For the guaranteed Top 3 placement on the Standard and Quarterly packages - 90 days. Speed depends on niche competitiveness and your profile's current state.

q2.question: How do you track and report progress?
q2.answer: We monitor your Google Maps ranking weekly using specialist tools. You receive bi-weekly updates with concrete data on your ranking position, impressions, and user actions - calls, direction requests, and website visits.

q3.question: What if our competitors are also doing local SEO?
q3.answer: Competitor analysis is the first step of our process. We know exactly what the top-ranking businesses are doing and how to outpace their strategy. In 9 out of 10 cases, our clients reach the Top 3 even when competitors are actively investing in local SEO.

q4.question: What are citations and why do they matter?
q4.answer: A citation is any online mention of your business that includes your name, address, and phone number (NAP). Google uses the consistency and quality of these mentions as a trust signal. We build high-quality citations in authoritative, industry-specific directories relevant to your location.

q1.question: How exactly does the money-back guarantee work?
q1.answer: For the Standard and Quarterly packages: if we do not achieve a Top 3 ranking for the agreed keyword within 90 days, you receive a full refund of all amounts paid. The guarantee applies provided you granted us the required access on time and did not make changes to your profile without our knowledge.

q2.question: Are there any hidden setup fees or additional costs?
q2.answer: None. The price you see is everything you pay. No setup fees, no hidden add-ons, no performance charges. The monthly fee covers all work - analysis, optimisation, citations, and updates.

q3.question: Can I upgrade or switch plans later?
q3.answer: Yes. If you decide to move from Minimum to Standard, or switch to quarterly billing - just get in touch. The price difference is calculated on a pro-rata basis with no penalties.

q4.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q4.answer: We accept bank transfers in euros (EUR). The quarterly plan automatically saves you €150 compared to three monthly payments - €1,185 instead of €1,335.

cookiePage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePage.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Atlas Fold uses - or more accurately, does <italic>not</italic> use - cookies on the <highlight>atlasfold.com</highlight> website.

section1.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
section1.p1: Cookies are small text files placed on your device by a website to store information about your visit - typically used for analytics, advertising, and session management.

section2.title: 2. We Don't Use Tracking Cookies
section2.highlightTitle: ✓ No tracking cookies are set on this website.
section2.highlightDesc: We do not use Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, or any other cookie-based tracking tools.
section2.p1: This website uses <highlight>Vercel Analytics</highlight> and <highlight>Vercel Speed Insights</highlight> to understand page performance and visitor trends. Both tools are <highlight>cookieless by design</highlight> - they use server-side edge data and aggregate metrics without setting any cookies or fingerprinting individual users.
items: Set any first-party or third-party cookies
Collect personally identifiable information
Track users across different websites or sessions over time
Use IP addresses for individual identification
section2.p3: You can read more about Vercel's privacy model at <vercelLink>vercel.com/docs/analytics/privacy-policy</vercelLink>.

section3.title: 3. Embedded Content
section3.p1: Our website embeds a <highlight>Google Maps iframe</highlight> in the footer to show our location. When this iframe loads, Google may set its own cookies on your device in accordance with Google's privacy policy. This is the only third-party element present on the site that may involve cookies. You can review Google's cookie practices at <googleLink>policies.google.com/technologies/cookies</googleLink>.

section4.title: 4. Your Browser Controls
section4.p1: Even though we don't set tracking cookies, you always have full control via your browser settings. You can view, block, or delete any cookies stored by any website through your browser's privacy or security settings.

section5.title: 5. Contact
section5.p1: If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy, please contact us at <emailLink>antoan@atlasfold.com</emailLink>.
